arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Olson argued the per se rule is misguided and anticompetitive.
Coykendall argued discouraging price cuts is bad antitrust policy.
Hungar argued the Dr. Miles rule conflicts with modern jurisprudence.
Underwood argued the agreement prevents discounts and price competition.
